title: Ex 1.3 #7 · Subsets of {ℝ, {ℚ, ℕ}}
prompt: List all the subsets of $\{\mathbb{R}, \{\mathbb{Q}, \mathbb{N}\}\}$. Enter them together as one set of sets between outer braces, like $\{\emptyset, \{1\}\}$.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: This set has two elements: ℝ and the set {ℚ, ℕ}.
A set with k elements has 2ᵏ subsets, including ∅ and the set itself: here that's 4.
solution: The set has 2 element(s), so it has 4 subset(s), from ∅ up to the whole set.
